content.value_statement: Competitor research often produces inconsistent facts and unsupported conclusions. This skill combines public website, review, and SEO evidence into comparable profiles.
actual_capabilities: Maps competitor websites and identifies relevant product, pricing, customer, integration, and changelog pages.
Extracts positioning, audience, features, pricing, customer evidence, and product direction signals.
Collects domain authority, backlinks, keyword rankings, traffic estimates, and high-value pages through DataForSEO.
Stores dated raw research outputs for later review, updates, and snapshot comparison.
Generates consistent Markdown profiles and a cross-competitor summary with strategic implications.
Supports quick scans, deep profiles, and scoped research that omits unneeded data sources.
limitations: Requires configured Firecrawl and DataForSEO MCP tools for live website and SEO research.
Public websites, review platforms, and SEO estimates may be incomplete, blocked, or outdated.
The skill does not verify private company data or confidential financial information.
Large competitor sets can consume significant API quota and should be prioritized.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Positioning
use_cases.description: Compare competitor messaging, audiences, features, and pricing to identify defensible positioning opportunities.

use_cases.title: Support Sales Strategy
use_cases.description: Create sourced competitor dossiers that help teams understand strengths, weaknesses, customer proof, and pricing.

use_cases.title: Plan Search Content
use_cases.description: Compare keyword coverage, organic traffic, backlinks, and top pages to find content opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Quick Competitor Scan
prompt_templates.prompt: Profile https://example.com with a quick scan. Focus on positioning, pricing, key features, and customer evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a fast overview of one competitor.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Three Competitors
prompt_templates.prompt: Profile these competitors: [URLs]. Compare their pricing, target audiences, positioning, organic strength, and major product differences.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when evaluating a defined competitive set.

prompt_templates.title: Update an Existing Profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the existing profile for [competitor]. Recheck pricing, SEO metrics, and recent releases, then document changes since [date].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this to refresh a previous research snapshot.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Deep Strategic Landscape
prompt_templates.prompt: Create deep profiles for [URLs]. Emphasize [focus areas], compare each against [our product], and identify evidence-based opportunities and threats.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for comprehensive strategic planning.

output_examples.input: Profile one competitor with a quick scan focused on pricing and positioning.
output_examples.output: A dated Markdown profile summarizes the homepage message, target audience, pricing tiers, notable features, customer evidence, and cited source pages.

output_examples.input: Compare three competitors using website and SEO data.
output: Three consistent competitor profiles with raw source references.
A summary compares positioning, pricing, domain strength, traffic, keywords, strengths, weaknesses, and market opportunities.

output_examples.output: The updated profile preserves prior raw data, adds a new dated snapshot, refreshes volatile metrics, and records changes in a changelog.

best_practices: Provide verified competitor URLs, your product context, the desired depth, and priority research dimensions.
Use identical metrics and source types for every competitor to preserve comparability.
Review cited evidence and label estimates or inferences before using conclusions in strategic decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not treat homepage claims, customer logos, or review excerpts as verified facts without cross-checking.
Do not request deep profiles for large lists without prioritizing competitors and controlling crawl limits.
Do not overwrite prior snapshots, because dated raw data supports audits and change tracking.

faq.question: What input does this skill require?
faq.answer: Provide competitor URLs and your product context. You can also specify scan depth and priority topics.

faq.question: What is included in a quick scan?
faq.answer: A quick scan covers homepage messaging, pricing, domain overview, ranked keyword summaries, and an abbreviated profile.

faq.question: What does a deep profile add?
faq.answer: It adds more site pages, reviews, backlinks, technology signals, keyword intelligence, content strategy, and detailed competitive implications.

faq.question: Can I skip SEO research?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can focus on selected website sections and mark SEO data as not collected.

faq.question: How are sources preserved?
faq.answer: The skill saves raw scrapes, SEO responses, and review data in dated folders referenced by each profile.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee accurate competitor data?
faq.answer: No. It relies on public sources and third-party estimates, so important claims require review and cross-checking.
